prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use refined warm lifestyle editorial photography: considered light and composition with relaxed believable interaction, never a glossy advertising pose. A 38-year-old man in an indigo work shirt laughs at a comment outside the frame while standing at a clean woodworking bench. A small unfinished wooden object rests near his relaxed hands. Use carefully composed late-afternoon side light, tactile wood grain, neatly stored background tools, and an unforced environmental portrait. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct invented appearance: close-cropped copper-red hair, light ginger stubble, a square jaw, light-blue eyes, pale freckled skin and broad shoulders.
Composition priority: exact wide 16:9 aspect ratio. Step the camera back to an environmental medium-wide view. ALL main people, faces, arms, hands and key props must fit entirely in the central 55 percent of image width, leaving substantial believable room or scenery at BOTH sides.
review: Reviewed full image: copper-haired man with ginger stubble smiles beside a wooden bench. Both hands are clearly attached, with plausible visible fingers around a small wooden bowl; tools stay in the background. Figure and gestures are central, with side context. Horizontal 1672x941 matches 16:9 within one pixel.
